entities.summary: "Leave Before You Love Me" is a song by American record producer Marshmello and American group Jonas Brothers. It was released through Republic Records and Joytime Collective as a single on May 21, 2021. Produced by Marshmello and co-produced by Alesso, Digital Farm Animals, and Heavy Mellow, the producers wrote the song alongside Richard Boardman and Pablo Bowman of the songwriting collective the Six, Phil Plested, and William Vaughan. Christian Arnold, David Martin and Geoff Morrow of the band Butterscotch are also credited as songwriters, due to an interpolation of their song "Can't Smile Without You" in the chorus of "Leave Before You Love Me".

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The song 'Leave Before You Love Me' by Marshmello and Jonas Brothers had a moderate impact on popular music in 2021, reaching number one on the US Billboard Hot 100 chart and being certified multi-platinum. Its release contributed to the continued success of the artists involved.
